items.originalTitle: Kimi Antonelli becomes youngest world champion in F1 history
detailZh: 基米·安东内利成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军
基米·安东内利在墨西哥大奖赛上赢得了他的首个世界冠军
对于梅赛德斯车迷来说，这里是关于银箭的最新消息，包括来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析。
基米·安东内利在墨西哥大奖赛上获得第三名后，成为了F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军。
梅赛德斯车手需要在阿特尔多莫·赫尔曼诺斯·罗德里格斯赛道举行的比赛中至少获得第九名，才能赢得他的首个冠军头衔。在20岁68天的时候，他打破了四届冠军车手塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔创下的纪录，维特尔在2010年以23岁134天的大龄首次赢得红牛车队冠军时打破了这一纪录。
他也成为了自1953年的阿尔贝托·阿斯卡里以来首位赢得冠军的意大利车手。
在F1的第二赛季，安东内利在第三轮锦标赛中就取得了领先，这是在连续赢得中国和日本大奖赛之后实现的。
从那时起，他一路高歌猛进，在赛季上半年的迈阿密、加拿大、摩纳哥和比利时大奖赛中又赢得了四个冠军。在意大利、西班牙和奥斯汀的夏季休赛期之后，他又赢得了三个大奖赛。
因此，安东内利在墨西哥大奖赛开始前，已经领先他的梅赛德斯队友乔治·拉塞尔123分，现在他在赛季还剩四轮的情况下已经锁定了冠军。红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘赢得了墨西哥大奖赛，刘易斯·汉密尔顿获得了第二名。
车手积分榜第二名的争夺战仍在进行。
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli becomes youngest world champion in F1 history
Kimi Antonelli secured his maiden championship at the Mexican Grand Prix
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Kimi Antonelli has become the youngest Formula 1 world champion after finishing third at the Mexican Grand Prix.

The Mercedes driver needed to finish at least ninth in the race at the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez to claim his maiden title. At 20 years and 68 days old, he has broken the record set by four-time champion Sebastian Vettel, who was 23 years and 134 days old when he won his first title with Red Bull in 2010.
He has also become the first Italian driver to win a title since Alberto Ascari in 1953.
In only his second season in F1, Antonelli took the lead in the standings at the third round of the championship after back-to-back wins at the Chinese and Japanese Grands Prix.

From that moment, he went from strength to strength, securing a further four grand prix victories in the first half of the season in Miami, Canada, Monaco and Belgium. He has since won three grands prix following the summer break in Italy, Spain and Austin.

As a result, Antonelli had built a 123-point lead over his Mercedes team-mate George Russell heading into the Mexican Grand Prix, and now he has secured the title with four rounds remaining in the season. Red Bull's Max Verstappen won the Mexican Grand Prix and Lewis Hamilton finished second.
The fight is still on for second in the drivers’ standings.
keyPointsZh: 打破了塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔的纪录
keyPointsEn: He broke the record set by Sebastian Vettel
